> Project Orbit: draft a launch plan. Keep unfinished work distinct from done work.

The note gives the project name and the instruction above. It does not state
launch scope, dates, owners, audience, or channels, so none are assumed here.

## Practical next step

Write down the launch scope for Orbit in one paragraph: what is being launched,
to whom, and what "launched" means. Every other item in this plan depends on
that definition.

## Work status

### Completed

Nothing is confirmed complete. The source note does not report any finished
work, and nothing has been verified independently.

rather than tasks named in the note.
